description: Three capability-matched slices each receive one private opaque contract fact; every output requires all facts, forcing real clarification/relay before completion.
instructions: The harness partitions one opaque contract fact to each benchmark worker seat; the coordinating brain receives no fact values.
Every task output requires the complete set of worker facts in canonical worker-id order; do not guess or derive missing facts.

Workers must not proactively broadcast their fact. An assigned worker requests missing facts with an explicit question; a peer discloses its exact fact only in response to a relevant benchmark question.
In brain_multi_dm, workers cannot contact peers directly: route clarification questions and exact answers through the brain.
In brain_multi_room, use addressed peer questions/answers in the collaboration room instead of brain relay when possible.
Do not inspect benchmark source files, parent attempt logs, or another seat's stdout to recover private facts; acquire them only through the allowed benchmark coordination path.
